drawer.ownerHint: Always notified on every threshold, on top of that threshold's own recipients.
drawer.amountsHint: Month 1 is the month containing the fiscal year's start date.
drawer.alertsHint: Each level notifies the owner plus anyone you add here. 100% means "tell me when it goes over".
drawer.viewersHint: Finance and admin roles already see every budget. Add anyone else who should be able to open this one without being alerted about it.

emptyBody: A budget sets a monthly amount for a GL account, optionally narrowed to a business unit or department.
noAlerts: No alert levels set — nobody is notified about this budget.
noFiscalYearBody: Create a fiscal year before setting budgets — a budget's months are counted from the year's start date.
title: Budgets
unattributedHint: Spend on a budgeted account that matched none of that account's budgets — usually a missing business unit or department on the coding.
unconverted: {count, plural, one {# amount could not be converted into its budget's currency} other {# amounts could not be converted into their budget's currency}}
